Cabela's Outdoor Adventures.name: Cabela's Outdoor Adventures
Cabela's Outdoor Adventures.summary:
Join Mama, Papa, Ichigo, and Ringo as they explore as a family on a tropical island.

Take the Hunting & Fishing expedition of a lifetime with 22 adventures across North America and beyond. Stalk monster bucks and trophy big game or stop off and fish the local waters.

Experience the sights and sounds of a true-to-life outdoor adventure where stealth, strategy and technique are of the utmost importance!

Future GPX Cyber Formula - Road to the E.name: Future GPX Cyber Formula: Road to the Evolution
Future GPX Cyber Formula - Road to the E.summary: Future GPX Cyber Formula: Road to the Evolution is a futuristic racing game based on the Shinseiki GPX anime series, featuring a higher speed version of Formula One racing.
